name: Beef and Broccoli
desc: Thin-sliced flank steak and crisp-tender broccoli in a sweet soy-ginger sauce over rice.

source.title: Beef and Broccoli Recipe
source.evidence: Every amount matches the recipe card (1 lb flank steak, 6 tbsp low-sodium soy, 3 tbsp light brown sugar, 1 1/2 tbsp cornstarch, 2 tbsp sesame oil) and the method is the same.

ingredients.raw: 1 lb flank steak, very thinly sliced against the grain into bite-sized strips
ingredients.prep: very thinly sliced against the grain into bite-sized strips

ingredients.raw: 2 tbsp olive oil (or vegetable oil), divided
1 lb fresh broccoli, cut into about 6 cups of florets
ingredients.prep: cut into about 6 cups of florets

ingredients.raw: 6 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce (or gluten-free tamari)

steps: Start the rice first so it is ready when the stir fry is done. For easier slicing, freeze the steak for 30 minutes, then slice it thinly against the grain.
Make the sauce: Combine all the sauce ingredients in a bowl and stir until the sugar dissolves. Set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the broccoli and saute for 4-5 minutes, partially covered, tossing several times, until bright green and crisp-tender. Remove to a plate.
Raise the heat to high and add the remaining 1 tbsp oil. Add the beef in a single layer and cook for 2 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through.
Stir the sauce again, pour it in, and reduce the heat to medium-low. Simmer for 3-4 minutes until thickened.
Return the broccoli to the pan and toss to coat. Thin with 1-2 tbsp water if the sauce is too thick. Serve over rice, sprinkled with sesame seeds.
tips: For softer broccoli, add 2 tbsp water before covering the pan so it steams.
